checks: A hidden/background native window keeps its confirmed current letter scrolling and polling with background throttling disabled
Configured 900px output clamps to the native 420px capture window; three mixed-ratio images remain fully visible and fixed below scrolling text, including enlargement of an 80px source
Shrinking to 300px resets the text loop; the final caption remains reachable and every image remains stationary and fully contained
180px output with 96px type, 32px padding and 70% requested image area preserves positive text space and fully contained images
Output blank destroys the animation, reopens a blank receiver and never restores the previous letter
limitations: Synthetic read-only IPC frames; no production inbox, OBS or live-software capture
